# Pinned libgitlfs release.
#
# A plain text file, not JSON: UnrealBuildTool does not reference a JSON parser
# when compiling .Build.cs rules assemblies on every engine version we support,
# and this needs to be readable from UE 4.27 through 5.8 with no dependencies.
#
# Format:
#   tag <release-tag>
#   <platform-key> <file-name> <sha256>
#
# A platform line with an empty or placeholder hash is treated as "not pinned
# yet": acquisition is skipped with a warning rather than downloading something
# unverified. Fill these in when the release is cut, from its SHA256SUMS.

tag lib-v1.0.0

mac    libgitlfs-darwin-universal.dylib 6f6042f7dfc7db106410577e00d55d9fc937c03368df91df4748663c287b1790
linux  libgitlfs-linux-amd64.so         e83ba28104aa5c658a9fbca485290243c78e805f528ccc387fb08bc69f467f35
